decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.The proposed wrap around dormer, by reason of its excessive size, bulk and appearance would be disproportionately large in relation to the roof and constitute an obtrusive feature which would be out of character with the established roofline of the adjoining properties and the street scene generally contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1 and H 6.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2. The proposed first floor side extension by reason of its excessive size, bulk and appearance and position would constitute an obtrusive feature infilling this open corner. It would be out of character with this property and those adjoining and would cause harm to the appearance of the area generally. It would therefore be contrary to policies ENV B.1.1 (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Adopted UDP and the Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 3 - 3. The proposed development by reason of its excessive size, bulk  and position would represent an over development of the site detrimental to the residential amenities of the adjoining properties by reason of enclosure, loss of outlook, overshadowing and loss of privacy and light, contrary to policies ENV B.1.1 (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Adopted UDP and the Residential Extensions Guidelines.
description: Erection of a first floor side extension and roof extension comprising wrap around dormer to house.
